opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, and must have submitted their doctoral thesis for viva by the closing date. Applicants must be based at a UK university or have a UK academic position.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to three years of salary support (100% of salary costs up to £56,000 in year 1 and 50% up to £28,000 in years 2‑3) and research expenses of up to £6,000 per year to enable early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher education institutions (including trial participation by UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply. Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution and responsible for directing the grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports innovative research projects at UK universities or eligible institutions, with grants up to £500,000 for up to five years. Requires at least 75% of the budget to fund research staff.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding areas excluded by the Trust)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or eligible specialist arts institutions) who will host an eminent overseas professor. The host must be based at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits by senior overseas professors to UK institutions, with awards ranging from £10k to £150k for programmes of 3‑12 months (up to 2 years total). Includes support for travel, maintenance, and related costs.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years of post‑PhD research or teaching experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated by a university), who have not previously led a research team or held a comparable award.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1 million over 4‑5 years to enable talented early‑career academics to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and producing high‑impact research.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding disease/clinical, policy‑driven, advocacy, and commercial research)
